description: This file defines the ICachePressureMonitor interface, which is used for monitoring cache pressure in the Orleans streaming system, specifically within the EventHubs provider. It includes methods for recording cache pressure contributions, checking if the cache is under pressure, and a property for setting a cache monitor.

classes.name: ICachePressureMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring cache pressure, including recording pressure contributions, checking pressure status, and referencing a cache monitor.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution value to the monitor.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines whether the cache is under pressure based on the current UTC time.
